additional_info.subject: ID0459354-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/SN 313981068001] Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1230800921 status CRM:03098000141
additional_info.body:
Hello Lara, good morning.
I checked the logs and it seems that the error is related to fix in the upcoming version v8.1. This error is related to some specific brands that cause a negative value on our system to appear and the LEM assumes it's an error.
This will always happen as long as the EV is sending this negative value to the LEM meter. So the idea is that even though the error happens, it doesn't cause any constraint for the energy metering.
Please align with Johannes for the upcoming v8.1 release.
Since I have provided all the information required for this incident, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
